title: Larkspur Lock & Shop Rate Hold Terms and Conditions
content:
Larkspur Home Lending offers a Lock & Shop rate hold under the Mortgage Pre-Approval only at a level with a rate hold available, and among the Mortgage Pre-Approval levels that is the Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval.

## Terms

**1. Availability.** Only a level with a rate hold available offers a rate hold. The Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval offers a hold of 90 calendar days for a fee of USD 595.00. The Larkspur Pre-Qualification, Pre-Approval, Verified Pre-Approval, Underwritten Pre-Approval and Jumbo Underwritten Pre-Approval offer no hold; for them the hold length is 0 days and the fee USD 0.00.

**2. Placing the hold.** The hold is placed on payment of the rate hold fee and runs the level's hold length in calendar days from the hold date. The held rate and the last day of the hold are recorded on the pre-approval.

**3. Float-down.** If the current rate improves by at least 0.250 percentage points, the held rate may be lowered once where the level allows a float-down.

**4. What happens to the fee.** The fee is credited at closing when the converted loan closes under the held rate, where the level provides for that credit; refunded when Larkspur declines the application, where the level provides for that refund; and forfeited when the hold expires without an application or the borrower withdraws, where the level provides for forfeiture of an unused fee. The Larkspur Lock & Shop Pre-Approval provides for all three.

**5. One disposition per fee payment.** A hold fee credit, refund or forfeiture disposes only of a fee entry not already disposed of.

**6. The fee while it is held.** Larkspur holds the Lock & Shop rate hold fee pending closing, refund or forfeiture.

## Fee outcomes at a glance

| What happens | Outcome for the fee paid |
|---|---|
| The converted loan closes under the held rate | credited at closing |
| Larkspur declines the application | refunded |
| The hold expires without an application | forfeited |
| The borrower withdraws | forfeited |

## Illustrations (hypothetical rates and events)

- **Float-down met.** The held rate is 6.750 percent and the current rate falls to 6.500 percent, an improvement of 0.250 percentage points. That is at least the required improvement, so the held rate may be lowered, once.
- **Float-down not met.** The held rate is 6.750 percent and the current rate is 6.550 percent, an improvement of 0.200 percentage points, which is less than 0.250; the held rate is not lowered.
- **Float-down already used.** A held rate already lowered once is not lowered a second time, whatever the later improvement.
- **Fee already disposed of.** A fee payment that has been credited at closing is not then also refunded or forfeited; a fee entry that has been refunded is not then credited or forfeited.
